chapters.title: Join a game
chapters.text: Scan the QR code on the big screen, or enter the code. No name needed.

chapters.title: Play as an individual or group
chapters.text: One person taps Create a new group and answers for the team. Teammates tap Join your group.

chapters.title: Start the game
chapters.text: Tap Zoom for details, discuss, then pick Real or AI generated.

chapters.title: Results & leaderboard
chapters.text: Answers are revealed one by one on the big screen. Then your phone shows your score and rank.
